info.name: EMS Backend - Full Master API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman API Collection covering all 10 modules: User, Company, Department, Designation, Role, Permission, Project, Employee, Module, and Permission Set.

item.name: User API

request.description: Register a new user in the system.
Authenticate user and receive JWT access and refresh tokens.
Obtain a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Get paginated list of users with search and filter capabilities.
Create a user directly from the User List endpoint (Admin mode).
Retrieve details of a specific user by ID.
Retrieve users with INACTIVE status waiting for admin approval.
Reject and lock a pending user registration.

item.description: API collection for User Management and Authentication in EMS Backend
